description: Search verified golf clubs and courses across Europe (e.g. GB, DE, FR, ES, SE, IE, NL, IT, PT) by name fragment, ISO country code and municipality. Returns summary records (country, holes, green fee range, last_verified; no sources[]); call get_club or list_sources_for for provenance before citing.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. ES

question.description: The golfer's question, as asked (optional). It is stored, cleaned of personal data, and shown to the club as what golfers ask; it does not change the answer.

name: search_clubs
